title: aria nivea var. glabrata
intro: Aria nivea var. glabrata, commonly known as White Sagebrush, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is native to North America and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aria nivea var. glabrata include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
